Record Class PolymerDefinition

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
io.github.wurtzitane.avogadro.api.PolymerDefinition
Record Components:
repeatUnit - the structure fragment representing the repeating unit
head - the zero-based index of the head atom in the repeat unit
tail - the zero-based index of the tail atom in the repeat unit
translation - the Cartesian displacement vector between successive units
linkType - the bond type used to link repeat units together
headCap - the terminal cap structure at the head of the chain
tailCap - the terminal cap structure at the tail of the chain
previewUnits - the number of units rendered in previews
public record PolymerDefinition(StructureFragment repeatUnit, int head, int tail, PolymerDefinition.Vector translation, BondType linkType, PolymerDefinition.Cap headCap, PolymerDefinition.Cap tailCap, int previewUnits) extends Record
A recipe for a single polymer chain: a repeating piece and optional groups at its ends.

The chain preview uses a chosen repeat count. This recipe describes that authored model, rather than the range of chain lengths found in a real polymer sample. Use PolymerNetworkDefinition for branches, crosslinks, or adjustable network recipes.
